repo_notes.content: A starter template. Streaming and memory are the two subsystems readers come for.
repo_notes.author: rei-doc-specialist

repo_notes.content: tests/unit holds 21 of the repo test files; it is the densest description of intended behaviour in the repo.
repo_notes.author: rei-doc-specialist

pages.title: Chatbot Architecture
pages.purpose: How a message travels from input to streamed reply: the chat loop, provider selection, memory read and write, and the plugin hooks along the way.

pages.title: Streaming
pages.purpose: The streaming implementation under src/streaming/: token delivery, backpressure, cancellation and partial-response handling.

pages.title: Memory
pages.purpose: Conversation memory under src/memory/: what is stored, how history is trimmed to fit a context window, and how memory is persisted between sessions.

pages.title: Providers
pages.purpose: The provider abstraction under src/providers/: adding a model backend, the differences the abstraction hides, and error and retry behaviour.

pages.title: Plugins and Middleware
pages.purpose: Extending the chat loop: the plugin interface under src/plugins/ and the middleware chain under src/middleware/.

pages.title: Examples
pages.purpose: The simple, streaming and advanced chat examples, and which subsystem each one exercises.

pages.title: Testing
pages.purpose: The Vitest layout and what the unit, provider and integration tiers each cover.
